attribution.dimensions: Singapore Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI (curated local interpretation)
attribution.aicm: Cloud Security Alliance AICM v1.1 (control IDs attributed below; catalogue not reproduced)

controls.outcome: External destinations are explicit and reviewed before consequential transfer.
controls.consequence: Data or an agent action may cross the named local boundary.

controls.outcome: Sensitive or secret data is not sent to an unapproved external destination.
controls.consequence: A sensitive-data egress could be irreversible or difficult to contain.

controls.outcome: Write, delete, publish, and execute effects have action-bound expiring approval.
controls.consequence: The action can change or publish state on behalf of the operator.

controls.outcome: Elevated or administrator privileges are visible and explicitly approved.
controls.consequence: A broad permission set can amplify an otherwise bounded action.

controls.outcome: Broad permission sets are visible before a consequential action uses them.
controls.consequence: A broad tool or MCP permission can expand the action's effect beyond its named purpose.

controls.outcome: Low-reversibility actions receive explicit review before proceeding.
controls.consequence: A mistake may be difficult to undo or contain.

controls.outcome: New or changed runtimes, tools, MCP servers, and permission sets receive review.
controls.consequence: A material change can invalidate an earlier conclusion.

controls.outcome: Intent, action, decision, effect, outcome, and verification gaps remain visible.
controls.consequence: An action may look approved or effective without a complete trace.

controls.outcome: Stale, failed, and unverified source claims request refreshed evidence.
controls.consequence: Current decisions may rely on historical or incomplete source state.

controls.outcome: Known local reads are recorded without repeated interruption.
controls.consequence: Routine work remains usable while its evidence is retained.
